what: The whole page is one map — the screen stays fixed and scrolling flies the camera from the whole map (hub) into a branch node pill (1), the pill text disappears at .26, the pill-shaped clip spreads to the full screen (1) and the pill color becomes that section’s background. After the section is read, it folds back into the pill in reverse, pulls back to the hub (1), then moves on to the next node. Scroll length = Screen height × timeline × .78, scrub .5
